pixie-cut: A classic pixie cut: the nape and sides are cut short and tapered close to the head, neatly trimmed around the ears so the ears are fully exposed, and the nape finishes in a soft, clean, close taper. The top and crown are left slightly longer, about 5 to 7 cm, cut in soft blended layers for gentle lift at the crown. A short, textured fringe is swept to one side, its tips ending around the eyebrows. Light, piecey finish with soft separated ends. No length remains below the nape hairline. Keep the natural hair texture.
pixie-longo: A long pixie cut: the nape is tapered short and close to the neck, while the sides are left longer, softly covering the upper half of the ears. The top is long, about 10 to 12 cm, cut in soft, blended layers that create movement and gentle volume at the crown. A long, side-swept fringe falls diagonally across the forehead to cheekbone level. Ends are point-cut for a soft, piecey finish. Nothing extends below the earlobes except a few soft wisps at the nape. Keep the natural hair texture.
curto-classico-volume: A classic short layered cut with rounded volume: the length sits at mid-ear on the sides and at the top of the nape, with the sides softly feathered back and half covering the ears. The crown and top are cut in short, round, graduated layers styled upward with a round-brush blow-dry for full, airy lift and a soft dome shape. A short fringe is brushed to the side, away from the forehead. Smooth, polished, bouncy finish with soft movement and no harsh edges. No length remains below the nape.
bixie-cut: A bixie cut, a hybrid between a pixie and a short bob: the hair is cut to about mid-ear to earlobe length all around, with a softly tapered, close nape. Shaggy, blended layers through the top and crown create rounded, airy volume, and the sides fall over the ears with longer, wispy front pieces at cheekbone level. A soft, wispy fringe is brushed slightly to the side. Textured, piecey, lived-in finish with feathered ends. No length reaches the jawline. Keep the natural hair texture.
pixie-repicado: A choppy, heavily layered pixie: short all over, with the sides and nape about 3 to 4 cm and the top about 6 to 8 cm, cut with point-cutting and razor texturizing into uneven, piecey layers of different lengths. The ears are exposed and the nape is tapered close. A short, choppy, irregular fringe falls loosely over the forehead. Styled tousled and slightly messy, with separated, defined pieces moving in different directions and light lift at the crown. Keep the natural hair texture.
pixie-franja-lateral: A side-swept pixie with a dramatic fringe: a deep side part, with the nape and sides cut very short and tapered close to the head, ears exposed. The top is longer and swept across the forehead into a long, asymmetric fringe that travels diagonally to the opposite side, its longest point reaching past the eyebrow toward the cheekbone. Sleek, softly layered crown with light lift at the root. Polished silhouette with thinned, tapered ends on the fringe. Keep the natural hair texture.
undercut-feminino: A pixie with an undercut: both sides and the nape are clipper-cut very short, about 3 to 6 mm, with a clean, disconnected line where the longer top section begins. The top section is left long, about 10 to 14 cm, and swept over to one side in a smooth, voluminous sweep with lift at the root, its ends falling over the shorter side. The contrast between the buzzed sides and the long top is sharp and clearly visible. Keep the natural hair texture on the top section.
pixie-assimetrico: An asymmetrical pixie: one side is cut very short and tapered close above the ear, while the opposite side is left noticeably longer, falling in a sleek, angled line down to the lower cheek, just above the jawline. The nape is tapered short and clean. The top is layered and gets longer toward the long side, with a deep side part and the hair swept diagonally toward the longer side. Sharp, precise perimeter lines with a smooth, polished finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
lateral-raspada: A short cut with one side shaved (side undercut): on one side only, the hair above and behind the ear is clipper-shaved very close, about 3 mm, with a crisp, clean edge. The rest of the hair is a longer pixie, about 8 to 12 cm on top, parted deeply on the shaved side and swept across to the opposite side, where it falls in soft layers over that ear. The nape is tapered short. The shaved area is clearly exposed. Keep the natural hair texture.
shag-curto: A short shag pixie (shixie): an above-the-jaw cut with very choppy, disconnected layers, short and full at the crown and top for rounded, fluffy volume. The sides are cut into wispy, feathered pieces that fall over the tops of the ears, and the nape is left slightly longer with thin, tapered wisps that flick outward. A wispy, broken-up fringe falls to the eyebrows and splits slightly in the middle. Razor-cut, airy, undone texture. Keep the natural hair texture.
pixie-degrade: A tapered pixie with a fade: the sides and nape are clipper-faded in a smooth gradient, from a near-zero clipper length at the neckline and around the ears up to about 1 to 2 cm higher on the head, with no visible lines. The top is left at about 4 to 6 cm, softly layered and blended into the fade, styled slightly forward and to one side with light texture. Clean, neat outline around the ears and nape. Keep the natural hair texture on top.
buzz-cut: A buzz cut: all the hair is clipper-cut to a uniform length of about 6 to 9 mm over the entire head, closely following the natural shape of the head. Even, soft, dense short hair with the natural hairline kept intact and neatly outlined around the ears and nape. No longer pieces, no fringe and no styling. Realistic short hair density, with the scalp only faintly visible through the hair.
corte-garconne: A garçonne cut in the 1920s Parisian style: very short and close to the head, with the nape and sides cut short and sleek behind and around the ears. The top is about 5 to 7 cm, combed smoothly from a defined side part and lying close to the head with very little volume. Short, neat sideburn pieces in front of the ears and a gentle sweep at the front. Sleek, smooth, sculpted finish with refined, tidy edges and natural shine.
pixie-soft: A soft, airy pixie: short and feathered, with the nape and sides softly tapered with scissors rather than clippers, leaving light, wispy edges that brush the tops of the ears and the nape. The top is about 7 to 9 cm, cut in weightless, blended layers that create a light, fluffy, feather-like movement. A wispy fringe falls softly onto the forehead, slightly to one side. Feathered, tapered ends with no hard lines, for a natural, effortless, lived-in finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
pixie-franja-cortina: A pixie with curtain bangs: the nape is tapered short and the sides are softly layered, falling just over the tops of the ears. The top is about 8 to 10 cm, layered for soft volume at the crown. The front is cut into curtain bangs parted in the center, sweeping outward to both sides and ending at cheekbone level in soft, feathered curves. Light, airy, balanced finish with movement at the front. Keep the natural hair texture.
crop-texturizado: A textured crop: the sides and nape are tapered short with a soft clipper fade, and the top is about 4 to 6 cm, cut with deep point-cutting for choppy, separated texture. All the top hair is pushed forward into a short, blunt-but-textured fringe that falls in a fairly straight line across the upper forehead, about 2 to 3 cm above the eyebrows. Matte, piecey, tousled finish with movement on top. Keep the natural hair texture.
corte-gamine: A gamine cut: a very short, rounded crop that follows the shape of the head, with the ears fully exposed and the nape tapered close and soft. The top and crown are about 4 to 5 cm, lightly layered for a soft, rounded silhouette. A very short, wispy micro fringe sits high on the forehead, well above the eyebrows, with delicate, slightly uneven tips. Soft wisps at the temples and in front of the ears. Light, feathery, delicate texture. Keep the natural hair texture.
micro-pixie: A micro pixie: an ultra-short crop, about 1.5 to 3 cm all over, slightly longer on top than at the sides and nape, closely following the natural shape of the head. The ears are completely exposed and the nape is clean and close. The top hair is softly pushed forward, ending in a tiny, textured micro fringe right at the front hairline. Minimal, natural, soft texture with no added volume. Keep the natural hair texture.
pixie-italiano: An Italian pixie: a full, voluminous, rounded pixie with a soft, bouncy shape. The nape is tapered short and the sides cover the upper part of the ears in soft, curved layers. The top and crown are long, about 9 to 11 cm, cut in rounded layers and styled with fullness, lift at the roots and a gentle inward bend at the ends. A long, soft fringe sweeps to the side and curves toward the cheekbone. Airy, luxurious, glossy movement. Keep the natural hair texture.
pixie-mullet: A pixie mullet: short, choppy layers on the top and crown with lift and texture, and the sides cut short and tapered above the ears. At the back, the nape is deliberately left longer, with soft, wispy, tapered pieces falling to the base of the neck, creating a clear short-front, longer-back contrast. A short, piecey fringe falls onto the forehead. Undone, razor-textured, edgy finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
pixie-ondulado: A wavy pixie: a short layered pixie with the nape tapered close and the sides softly covering the tops of the ears, the top about 7 to 10 cm. The hair is styled in soft, loose, natural-looking waves and bends throughout the top and fringe, with defined, separated wave pieces and airy volume. A wavy, side-swept fringe falls toward one eyebrow. Soft, touchable, tousled texture with natural shine and a realistic wave pattern strand by strand.
pixie-topete: A pompadour pixie: the sides and nape are cut short and tapered close to the head, neat behind the ears. The top is left long, about 10 to 12 cm, and styled up and back from the front hairline into a tall, rounded quiff with strong volume and height at the front, gradually lowering toward the crown. Smooth, polished sides contrast with the lifted top. Glossy, structured, retro-modern finish. Keep the natural hair texture on top.
pixie-espetado: A spiky pixie: short all over, with the sides and nape tapered at about 2 to 3 cm and the top layered at about 4 to 6 cm. The top and crown are styled straight up and slightly forward into separated, defined, pointed spikes, with strong lift at the roots and textured, pointed tips. Short, choppy pieces at the front with no long fringe. Matte, piecey, edgy texture, firmly styled in place. Keep the natural hair texture.
buzz-cut-degrade: A faded buzz cut (feminine crew cut): the top is clipper-cut to a short, even length of about 1 to 1.5 cm, while the sides and nape fade smoothly from that length down to a near-zero clipper length at the bottom, in a seamless gradient with no harsh lines. The natural hairline is kept intact with a neat, clean outline around the ears and nape. No fringe and no styling, just soft, dense short hair following the natural shape of the head.
raspado-total: A fully shaved head: all the hair is clipper-shaved very close, about 1 to 2 mm, uniformly over the entire head, leaving only a fine, even stubble that closely follows the natural shape of the head. The natural hairline shape is preserved and visible as a soft stubble outline. The scalp shows through the fine stubble in a realistic, natural way. No longer hair remains anywhere on the head.
moicano-feminino: A feminine mohawk: both sides of the head are clipper-shaved very close, about 3 mm, from the temples back to the nape, leaving a central strip about 6 to 8 cm wide running from the front hairline over the crown and down the back. The hair in this strip is about 8 to 12 cm long, styled upward into a lifted, textured crest with soft, piecey tips. Crisp, clean lines where the shaved sides meet the strip. Keep the natural hair texture in the strip.
faux-hawk: A feminine faux hawk: the sides and nape are cut short and tapered close but not shaved, about 1.5 to 2 cm. The top is longer, about 7 to 9 cm, layered and styled from both sides toward the center, rising into a soft, textured ridge of height along the middle of the head, highest at the front and crown. Piecey, separated texture with pointed tips and a matte, edgy finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
lateral-raspada-desenho: A short cut with a shaved side and a hair-tattoo design: on one side only, above and behind the ear, the hair is clipper-shaved very close, about 2 to 3 mm, and a clean geometric pattern of thin, sharp lines (parallel curves and angles) is carved into the shaved area. The rest of the hair is a long pixie, about 8 to 12 cm on top, swept from a deep part to the opposite side and falling softly over that ear. Crisp, perfectly clean design lines. Keep the natural hair texture.
pixie-franja-reta: A pixie with a blunt fringe: a short, rounded pixie with the nape tapered close and the sides trimmed neatly around the ears. A full, heavy, blunt fringe is cut in a straight horizontal line that sits just at the eyebrows, from temple to temple. The top is about 7 to 9 cm, smooth and rounded, blending into the fringe. Sleek, graphic, 1960s mod-inspired finish with clean lines. Keep the natural hair texture.
pixie-penteado-para-tras: A slicked-back pixie: the sides and nape are cut short and tapered close to the head, and the top is about 6 to 8 cm. All the hair is combed straight back from the front hairline, lying flat and smooth against the head with no fringe, styled with a glossy, wet-look gel finish so fine comb lines are subtly visible. Sleek, polished, editorial look with tidy edges behind the ears and at the nape.
corte-cogumelo: A bowl cut (mushroom cut): a short, rounded, one-length shape that circles the head like a dome. A heavy, blunt fringe sits just above the eyebrows and continues in a smooth, unbroken horizontal line around the sides at mid-ear level and across the back. Below that line, the nape is cut very short and close to the head. Smooth, full, rounded volume on top with crisp, sharp perimeter edges. Keep the natural hair texture.
pixie-ondas-retro: A finger-wave pixie: a short pixie with the nape and sides cut close, and the top hair about 6 to 8 cm set into sculpted 1920s finger waves, deep S-shaped ridges running in parallel across the top from a deep side part and lying close and flat to the head. Smooth, sleek sides. Highly polished, glossy, defined vintage finish with crisp, evenly spaced wave ridges.
wolf-cut-curto: A short wolf cut ending between the jawline and the chin: the top and crown are cut in very short, choppy, heavily disconnected layers for a full, rounded, shaggy dome of volume, the sides are razored into wispy pieces that fall over the ears, and the back is left slightly longer, tapering into thin, piecey wisps that reach the base of the neck. Short curtain bangs part in the center and fall to the cheekbones, blending into the top layers. Tousled, separated, razor-textured, edgy finish. Keep the natural hair texture.
curto-com-permanente: A short permed cut: the hair is cut in short, rounded layers about 5 to 8 cm long, sitting at mid-ear on the sides and at the top of the nape, and set all over in small, soft, springy curls about 1.5 cm in diameter, as from a classic perm or roller set. The curls are lightly brushed out into a full, rounded, airy cap of volume, highest at the crown, with the front curls lifted up and back off the forehead and the ears partly uncovered. Soft, bouncy, well-defined curls with a natural sheen and a tidy outline.
